newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:
Vessels: Avon loading 19,500 tonnes soybeans/meal. Velos loading 49,463 tonnes soymeal. Forward 2 loading 40,000 tonnes soybeans. Sotiras loading 52,000 tonnes soybeans.

Waiting to dock, 10 vessels to load soymeal, nine to load soybeans and two to load mixed cargo (soybeans/meal). Road: 921 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on April 22, 496 trucks with soymeal and 63 with vegetable oils, including soyoil.

Loading: 44,133 tonnes soybeans, 16,572 tonnes soymeal. In the month to April 22, Paranagua loaded 685,746 tonnes soybeans and 522,708 tonnes soymeal. This compares with 480,993 tonnes and 422,114 tonnes respectively in the same period in 1996.

Waiting to dock, Stefania to load 28,400 tonnes soymeal, Glory Hope to load 53,000 tonnes soybeans, Horizon to load 55,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Orleta Lwowskie loading 57,855 tonnes soybeans. Finix waiting to dock, to load 24,900 tonnes soybeans.
